GRAND THEFT AUTO VI CHARACTER TRANSFORMATION | CINEMATIC GAME LOADING SCREEN

Transform the person in the uploaded photograph into a highly detailed, visually striking character illustration inspired by the official Grand Theft Auto VI promotional artwork and its distinctive visual aesthetic. Reimagine the person as if they were an actual character living inside the GTA VI universe, with authentic illustrated textures, bold outlines, expressive details, vibrant colors, and polished video-game promotional artwork.

CHARACTER TRANSFORMATION & IDENTITY

Preserve the person's recognizable identity, facial structure, hairstyle, skin tone, expression, and defining physical features while naturally adapting their appearance into the GTA-inspired illustrated art style. Maintain the original person's overall appearance, but allow creative freedom in styling, clothing details, accessories, and character presentation where appropriate. The character should feel like an authentic protagonist from an open-world crime-action game rather than a generic cartoon illustration.

ENVIRONMENT & BACKGROUND

Create an immersive Vice City-inspired environment that complements the character. Use atmospheric sunset skies, tropical palm trees, stylish architecture, urban landscapes, coastal scenery, neon accents, or other cinematic surroundings that suit the subject. Introduce dramatic lighting, rich pink, purple, orange, and warm golden tones, detailed environmental elements, and the unmistakable atmosphere of a modern open-world game.

GTA VI GRAPHIC ELEMENTS

Integrate a prominent Grand Theft Auto VI logo near the upper-right corner, styled like official game promotional artwork. Include authentic-looking graphic elements and a cinematic loading-screen aesthetic. Near the bottom of the composition, incorporate a subtle loading indicator with the text "LOADING..." and a sleek horizontal progress bar with a vibrant pink or purple gradient.

ORIGINAL PHOTO — PICTURE-IN-PICTURE INSET

Place the untouched original uploaded photograph inside a small rectangular picture-in-picture frame positioned in the bottom-right area of the main artwork. Give the inset a clean, slightly thick white border, softly rounded corners, and a subtle shadow for a raised photographic appearance. The original image must remain completely photographic and unedited, preserving its actual colors, appearance, and composition. Keep the inset clearly visible without obstructing the main character.

FINAL COMPOSITION & QUALITY

The transformed character and cinematic environment should occupy the entire canvas, with the original photograph appearing as a smaller reference window integrated naturally into the artwork. Maintain professional composition, accurate proportions, crisp illustration details, rich color grading, and a cohesive visual identity. The result should resemble a premium GTA VI character reveal or official game loading-screen poster.

Vertical 4:5 composition, high resolution, sharp details, polished cinematic game artwork.
